name: Key fob: lock, unlock, trunk
note: No unlock or immobilizer frames on the Mazda bus.

name: Windows, trunk and locks by voice or WebUI
note: Named commands only. Confirm wiring from the diagrams.

note: Distance-indexed columns. Light sources hidden behind the print.

note: Legal functions run from factory signals. Animations need the show switch and parked.

note: Represents RPM, not true rotor position.

note: Factory warning indicators keep their stock colors.
